objective: Compile the fully qualified 66-requirement topology, assessment-target bindings, and dependency dispositions into one deterministic Learning runtime execution blueprint without inventing instructional content, automated scoring authority, human outcomes, or production activation.
runtime_binding_rules: Use the existing Course/Skill/Criterion/Lesson/Item vocabulary; do not create a competing Learning truth model.
Compile one Skill and one Criterion for each of the 66 qualified subskills/assessment targets.
Translate only already-admitted PREREQUISITE edges into hard_prerequisite_skill_ids; expected hard-gate count is exactly 2.
The 38 rejected hard-prerequisite candidates must never become mandatory gates.
The 8 retained UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL relationships must remain nonblocking and must not become mandatory gates.
Use stable frozen-source order as the deterministic tie-break for topological execution order.
Create lesson specifications from qualified capability/objective identities but do not fabricate explanatory source content or worked examples that have not been independently grounded.
Bind each qualified assessment target, its prompt contract, scoring assertions, insufficient-evidence behavior, and evidence boundaries to its Criterion.
Do not materialize an Item as independently scorable merely because a rubric exists. Automated scoring remains blocked until a qualified behavior/rubric oracle is bound.
Resulting course standing is READY_FOR_REVIEW and runtime_activation_allowed=false until instructional grounding, scoring-oracle qualification, and required review gates are satisfied.
Completion, confidence, generated text, or hosted structural qualification cannot create learner mastery.

compiled_output_schema.hard_prerequisite_edges: skill-level mandatory gates admitted by qualified topology only
compiled_output_schema.dependency_dispositions: all 46 001C dispositions preserved for audit; rejected/noncanonical relationships are nonblocking

successor_on_pass: Materialize independently grounded lesson/practice content and bind qualified scoring/oracle behavior against this exact 001D blueprint before activation.
